description: This file is a shell script used for testing the gitweb web interface. It runs a series of automated tests to verify the functionality of gitweb features such as repository listing, commit details, diffs, tags, logs, and more. It includes setup commands, test cases, and expectations for various gitweb behaviors.

methods.name: gitweb_run
methods.description: Function that executes a gitweb-related command or URL, used to test various gitweb actions and pages.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case that expects success, running the provided commands and checking the output.

methods.name: test_when_finished
methods.description: Registers commands to run after the current test case, usually for cleanup or state restoration.

methods.name: test_might_fail
methods.description: Conditional test execution based on the environment, e.g., presence of highlighting tools.

methods.name: test_config
methods.description: Sets or queries git config variables for testing conditions.

methods.name: test_ln_s_add
methods.description: Creates a symbolic link between files for testing symlinks.

methods.name: test_chmod
methods.description: Changes file modes/permissions for testing mode-specific features.

methods.name: test_lazy_prereq
methods.description: Conditional prerequisite checks for features that depend on external tools.

methods.name: test
methods.description: A generic test command or utility used in the testing framework.
